title: Accurately
subtitle: 正確地、精確地、完全準確地、準確無誤地、如實地、精準地——究竟是哪一種 accurately？
description: 正確地、精確地、完全準確地、準確無誤地、如實地、精準地——究竟是哪一種 accurately？

words.note: 最直接、最通用的近義詞之一，表示答案、資訊、操作、判斷或結果是對的，沒有出錯。
words.example: 這裡的 accurately 是『答案正確』、測量／定位精密、與原物完全一致、完全沒有錯誤、忠實重現、判斷正確，還是在事實層面準確？

exercises.original: She answered all the questions accurately.
exercises.zh: 她準確地回答了所有問題。
exercises.upgrade: correctly · 正確地

options.explanation: — correctly = 以正確方式／得到正確結果。 本句為何最合適： answers are right rather than merely detailed。
— precisely = 以高精度、精密程度完成或描述。 強調精密度；單純『答案答對』不一定需要 precisely。 本句判斷： answers are right rather than merely detailed。
— exactly = 與事實、數值、位置或原物完全一致。 強度較高，暗示完全一致；若只需一般正確，可能過強。 本句判斷： answers are right rather than merely detailed。
— faithfully = 忠實、如實地重現原內容或原物。 要求忠實重現來源；計算、定位、機器操作不適合。 本句判斷： answers are right rather than merely detailed。
— incorrectly = 錯誤地。 方向相反。 本句判斷： answers are right rather than merely detailed。
— approximately = 大約地，不是精確地。 只表示大約，和 precisely/exactly 相反。 本句判斷： answers are right rather than merely detailed。

falseSynonyms.zh: 精密不等於所有 accurately precisely 特別適合數值、位置、時間、技術操作；一般『回答正確』通常 correctly 更自然。
falseSynonyms.point: She answered correctly; the instrument measured precisely.

falseSynonyms.zh: 通常比 accurately 更強 exactly 常暗示完全一致，零偏差；accurately 可容許正常測量誤差範圍。
falseSynonyms.point: An accurate measurement may still be rounded; an exact value implies no discrepancy.

falseSynonyms.zh: 小心不保證準確 carefully 描述做事方式謹慎；結果仍可能出錯。
falseSynonyms.point: He measured carefully but not accurately.

falseSynonyms.zh: 忠實重現較窄 faithfully 適合翻譯、肖像、記錄、轉述；不適合一般計算。
falseSynonyms.point: The translation faithfully preserves the original meaning.

falseSynonyms.zh: 客觀不等於準確 objective 描述立場／方法不受偏見影響；資料仍可能不準確。
falseSynonyms.point: A report can be objective but factually inaccurate.

falseSynonyms.zh: 方向相反的高價值對比 approximately 表示大約；accurately / precisely 則強調接近真實或精確值。
falseSynonyms.point: The distance is approximately 10 km; it was measured accurately.

falseSynonyms.zh: 詞性陷阱 accurate 是形容詞；accurately 是副詞。
falseSynonyms.point: The result is accurate; the result was recorded accurately.

falseSynonyms.zh: 詞性陷阱 accuracy 是名詞；accurately 是副詞。
falseSynonyms.point: Accuracy matters; measurements must be taken accurately.
